data.name: MissingMapperTitle
data.value: Mapper registration is missing

data.name: MissingMapperMessage
data.value: '{0}' requires a mapper for '{1}', but no [MapperFor(typeof({1}))] registration was found in this compilation or its referenced assemblies

data.name: MissingMapperDescription
data.value: Add a MapperFor registration with the required function, pass an inline mapper, or use the corresponding As API. For runtime-only mapper assemblies, set artisan_orm.allow_external_mappers = true in .editorconfig.

data.name: MissingMethodTitle
data.value: Required mapper method is missing

data.name: MissingMethodMessage
data.value: Mapper '{0}' for '{1}' requires '{2}' according to RequiredMethod; expected {3}

data.name: MissingMethodDescription
data.value: The RequiredMethod values on MapperFor define methods that must be available even when no call site currently uses them.

data.name: InvalidSignatureTitle
data.value: Mapper method has an incompatible signature

data.name: InvalidSignatureMessage
data.value: Method '{0}' cannot be registered for '{1}'; expected a public static non-generic method compatible with {2}

data.name: InvalidSignatureDescription
data.value: MappingManager finds public methods by reflection and binds them to delegates. Parameters and return types must support that binding; numeric, boxing and user-defined conversions do not substitute for delegate compatibility.

data.name: DuplicateMapperTitle
data.value: Multiple mappers register the same type

data.name: DuplicateMapperMessage
data.value: Type '{0}' is registered by multiple mappers: {1}; MappingManager requires a single registration per type

data.name: DuplicateMapperDescription
data.value: MappingManager adds every MapperFor registration to a dictionary keyed by its target type, including mappers with different sets of methods.

data.name: AmbiguousMethodTitle
data.value: Mapper method lookup is ambiguous

data.name: AmbiguousMethodMessage
data.value: Reflection cannot select '{0}' unambiguously in mapper '{1}'; expected {2}

data.name: AmbiguousMethodDescription
data.value: Remove ambiguous overloads. CreateDataTable is looked up by name alone; other mapper methods are looked up using their input type.

data.name: RequiredByCallTitle
data.value: Operation requires a missing mapper function

data.name: RequiredByCallMessage
data.value: '{0}' requires '{1}' in mapper '{2}' for '{3}'; expected {4}

data.name: RequiredByCallDescription
data.value: A method can be optional in RequiredMethod but mandatory for a particular operation. DataTable operations require both CreateDataTable and CreateDataRow.

data.name: InvalidRegistrationTitle
data.value: Mapper registration cannot be used at runtime

data.name: InvalidRegistrationMessage
data.value: Mapper '{0}' has an invalid registration: {1}

data.name: InvalidRegistrationDescription
data.value: MapperFor needs a closed, usable target type and a non-null array of defined RequiredMethod values. Mapper methods cannot be registered from an open generic class.

data.name: InvalidTarget
data.value: MapperFor must specify a closed target type that can be used as a delegate type argument

data.name: OpenMapper
data.value: the mapper or its containing type has unbound type parameters

data.name: InvalidRequiredMethods
data.value: RequiredMethod must contain only defined values and must not be null
